name: AICTE Saksham Scholarship Scheme for Specially-Abled Student (Diploma)
provider: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE), Ministry of Education

rules.quote: Specially-abled student, having disability of not less than 40%.
The candidate should be admitted to First year of Diploma level course OR Second year of Diploma level course through lateral entry in any of the AICTE approved Institution
Family income from all sources should not be more than Rs. 8 lakh per annum during the current financial year.

rules.value: gap after qualifying exam not more than 2 years
rules.quote: The gap period between the year of passing the qualifying examination and the session of admission in diploma course should not be more than two years.

amount.text: Rs 50,000 per annum for every year of study (max 3 years; 2 for lateral entry)
amount.quote: Rs. 50,000/- per annum for every year of study i.e. maximum 3 years for first year admitted students and maximum 2 years second year admitted students

documents.name: Income certificate issued by State/UT Government
documents.quote: A valid income certificate issued by State/UT Government need to be enclosed.

deadline.text: AICTE notification dated 19.06.2026: last date for online applications 31.10.2026; NSP lists student application close 31-10-2026
deadline.quote: has been opened & last date for submission of online applications is 31 .10.2026
